`minds-admin env deploy` now stamps a git-owned workspace stop/start retention window over the Vault `storage` entry when the tier's `deploy.toml` declares one (`[storage] stop_retention_seconds`, pushed as `WORKSPACE_STOP_RETENTION_SECONDS`). The ci tier sets 60s and the dev tier 300s, so stop/start tests and dev iteration see the retention finalize (slot freed, restore path exercised) land in minutes instead of waiting out the connector's default hour-long instant-restart window; staging/production omit the block and keep the default.

Box prep now installs `zstd` from apt alongside the pinned `age` + `s5cmd` transfer tooling, so the connector's box-health sweep advice to re-run prep on a drifted box actually installs every binary the workspace stop/start transfers need.
